_comment: DRAFT spec for Make scenario 'GHL Call -> Note' (methods/ghl-call-transcripts.md). NOT a Make blueprint and NOT created in Make yet: build it in the Make UI from this list, run it once on a real call, then snapshot the real blueprint to platform-settings/blueprints/ghl-call-notes-<scenarioId>.json and fill make_scenarios.call_notes in platform-settings/ghl-calls.json. Module names verified against Make's app catalogue 2026-10-02 (highlevel v1, elevenlabs v1, anthropic-claude v1).

modules.hook: NEW highlevel hook on connection 4426112 for message events (InboundMessage, OutboundMessage). Existing GHL hooks all watch opportunities — do not reuse them.

modules.conditions: OR of ANDs: [[messageType = CALL (or TYPE_CALL), callStatus = completed, callDuration >= 8], [messageType = CALL (or TYPE_CALL), callStatus = voicemail]]
modules._gotcha: filter.conditions is an OR of ANDs — written inverted it can never be true (methods/content-folder-scenario.md).

headers.Authorization: Bearer <read PIT from a Make keychain>

modules.error_handler: on 404: Sleep 120 s, retry once (Break directive, 1 retry); still failing -> Ignore. The daily script picks the call up.
modules._verified: 2026-10-02 --probe: returns audio/x-wav, mono 8 kHz 16-bit PCM, for completed calls and voicemails

modules.body: multipart/form-data: file={{4.data}} (call.wav), model_id=scribe_v2, diarize=true, tag_audio_events=true, timestamps_granularity=word, language_code=en, keyterms=<one field per term from 5.data.terms>, additional_formats=[{"format":"txt","include_speakers":true,"include_timestamps":true}]
modules.why_not_the_native_module: elevenlabs:createSpeechToText supports scribe_v2/diarize/tag_audio_events but has no keyterms field; keyterms are the point (supplier and product names).
modules.error_handler: Ignore — no note; the daily script transcribes the call

modules.prompt:
You are writing the top of a call note for Titan Flooring, a flooring retailer and installer in the Greater Toronto Area. Below is a diarized transcript of one phone call. Direction: {{1.direction}}. Staff on the call: {{staff name from userId}}.

Write exactly this, plain text, nothing else:

Summary
<at most 3 sentences: who called, what they want, what was agreed. Name products, rooms, square footage and prices if said.>

Next steps
- Us: <what we promised> — by <date or 'no date given'>
- Customer: <what they will do> — by <date or 'no date given'>
(one line per commitment; write '- none' if nobody committed to anything)

Rules: only what was actually said; never invent dates or prices; if a speaker's role is unclear write 'unclear'. No coaching remarks about staff.

Transcript:
{{6.additional_formats[1].content}}

modules.builds: note body = {{7.text}} + blank line + 'Transcript (Scribe v2 · m:ss · direction · YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM · staff)' + transcript lines '[mm:ss] Speaker N: text' + blank line + footer
modules.footer: [call-note v1 messageId={{1.messageId}} conversationId={{1.conversationId}} engine=scribe_v2 part=k/N chars=<length>]
modules.split: if the body exceeds 4800 characters, cut the transcript at a line boundary into parts; parts k>1 start 'Transcript (k/N, continued)'. Format reference and parser: scripts/ghl_calls_pull.py render_call_note / parse_call_note.

modules.order: write continuation parts N..2 first, then part 1, so the Summary note is newest and shows on top

governance: Module 9 is a GHL write performed by Make, outside the ghl-actions-agent approval gate — the same class as Website Inquiry Ingester and the Stage scenarios. It writes exactly one thing, the call note. Recorded in CLAUDE.md and platform-settings/ghl-calls.json (Albert, 2026-10-01).
before_activating: Albert adds an ElevenLabs API key and a GHL read PIT to Make keychains
one manual run on a real call; confirm the note shows Summary, Next steps, Transcript in that order and the footer parses (python3 -c 'import scripts.ghl_calls_pull' … parse_call_note)
confirm the GHL contact-note length limit (split_chars 4800 assumes ~5000)
confirm whether the webhook's attachments[] already carries a recording URL (would remove module 4's sleep)
